integrity_statement: The proof is self-contained apart from standard definitions and graph terminology. Finite enumeration is supplementary and is explicitly separated from infinite deductions. No independent expert validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs with minimum degree at least two and girth at least five; a local sufficient condition broadens the class. Conditions are sufficient, not necessary; classification of all equality graphs or all extremal partitions is not claimed. A six-vertex girth-four boundary certificate relies on exhaustive enumeration, while the general theorem has a direct proof. Bibliographic priority remains subject to unindexed-equivalence risk.
title: Degree-sharp total outer-independent coalitions in high-girth graphs
